title: fccdb
description: Explore FCC ULS licenses, ASR antenna structures, and microwave path elevation profiles.
summary: Explore FCC ULS licenses, ASR antenna structures, and microwave path elevation profiles.
offersHint: Explore FCC ULS licenses, ASR antenna structures, and microwave path elevation profiles. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://fccdb.com/mcp

toolsPreview.name: search
toolsPreview.description: Free-text search across FCC call signs and licensee entity names. Returns up to 50 hits. Use this when the user names a callsign or company but you don't know the exact identifier yet.

toolsPreview.name: license_detail
toolsPreview.description: Full data for a single FCC license by call sign — licensee, locations with coordinates, antennas, paths, frequencies. Returns Markdown.

toolsPreview.name: tower_detail
toolsPreview.description: Full data for an antenna structure by ASR registration number — owner, location, height, declared licensees on the tower, microwave paths terminating there, and licensees within 50 m by spatial proximity. Returns Markdown.

toolsPreview.name: path_profile
toolsPreview.description: Metadata for a single microwave path on a license. Identified by the ULS USI (per-license integer) and the path number within that license. The HTML page has an SVG elevation chart with terrain + line of sight + Fresnel zone; the Markdown response carries the endpoints, length, and frequency but not the chart.
